mcq_fix.s: Consider the following pairs of early Indian art objects and their findspots: 1. Nude male torso — Lohanipur (Patna) 2. Portrait slab of Ashoka — Kanaganahalli (Karnataka) 3. 80-pillared hall — Rampurva Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?
mcq_fix.why: Kanaganahalli Ashoka slab is a Satavahana-era work, not Mauryan art; stem reworded, key unchanged

mcq_fix.s: Which of the following was the most famous centre of learning during the Mauryan period?
mcq_fix.why: stem had a numbered list and 'code' wording that did not fit single-choice options; cf. PYQ y23c35a07fa7

mcq_drop.why: dubious: Bharhut is not regarded as India's most ancient stupa (Sanchi/Piprahwa are older)

notes_fix.find: ⚠ Sanchi = India's largest stupa; Kesariya = largest brick stupa
notes_fix.replace: ⚠ Kesariya (Bihar) = largest stupa in the world (PYQ key); Sanchi = the 'best' stupa architecturally

Kesariya, not Sanchi, is the largest (PYQ y2c5897e339c)

notes_fix.replace: Lohanipur (Patna) / Kanaganahalli (Karnataka; Satavahana-era slab, not Mauryan)
notes_fix.why: Kanaganahalli portrait panel dates to c. 1st c. BCE-1st c. CE

pyq_bad.why: suspect key: Arthashastra = principles and practice of statecraft, not 'wealth accumulation'
suspect key: Dhamekh (Gupta) cannot precede Sanchi (Mauryan); option 4 reverses the order
suspect key: Bagh caves are Buddhist; wrong topic: cave architecture

patterns: APPSC asks: which art forms are Mauryan (Dhauli elephant, Didarganj Yakshi, Sanchi, Kumrahar - all four), oldest stone structure (Sanchi), Tamralipti as eastern port, silver coin Pana.

Other PSCs repeat: Megasthenes' seven classes, Barabar caves for Ajivikas (not Badami, not Chandragupta; inscriptions 3rd c. BCE), Ashokan pillars not parts of structures, Sanchi built by Ashoka, Pataliputra palace of wood, Manibhadra Yaksha at Parkham.
Arthashastra items: divorce to deserted wife, statecraft vs Prince of Machiavelli.
App MCQs are mostly sound but go deeper (slave categories, coin denominations, pillar part names, 2026 excavations) than the PYQ pattern.
